messages:
ci-bot: Build #374 failed: hosted-integ-suite / shard-04 — https://buildkite.example/runs/374 :x:

alex: Heads up — hosted-integ shard-04 is red, looks auth + streaming + toolcall schema all in one. Seen it on the daily smoke run too. :eyes:

priya: I grabbed the last failing log from runner-12, most requests are 401 from the auth-proxy. snippet:

```json
{"path":"/v1/chat.completions","status":401,"error":"missing token"}
```

noah: Also seeing stream resets during the same tests: "ERR_STREAM_RESET" coming from our runtime when client starts tool-calls. Example line:

```
runtime: stream closed by peer, code=ERR_STREAM_RESET seq=1452
```

maria: Ugh. Are these tied to the deployment this morning? Priya, which auth-proxy commit is running in staging-hosted?

priya: staging-hosted is on digest sha: ab12c9 (deployed 08:12am). I think token rotate job also rolled at 08:10am (k8s cron). Could be correlated.

alex: Can someone rerun shard-04 first before bisect? If it flakes again we should bisect between the previous green (sha: a9f3d2) and ab12c9. @noah can you grab a rerun?

noah: Rerunning shard-04 now (`./ci/scripts/rerun-shard.sh hosted-integ 04`) — kicking off buildkite rerun.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: Build #374.rerun-1 — https://buildkite.example/runs/374#rerun-1 :arrow_up:

oncall-bot: Quick checklist: if rerun fails, collect full auth-proxy env (FLAGS), token-rotate logs, and runtime stream traces. Tagging @oncall for paging.

maria: If it's the token-rotate job then the quick mitigation is to pin auth-proxy to previous image (a9f3d2) for hosted-tests while we investigate. We should avoid changing tests.

priya: Agree. I can pin the test cluster to a9f3d2 for the next 2 runs. Doing it now.

noah: Rerun finished — still failing but slightly different: mixture of 401s + one test failing on tool schema validation. Error snippet:

```
AssertionError: expected tool payload {"name": "lookup", "args": {...}} but got {"tool": "lookup", "params": {...}}
```

alex: That smells like a runtime mapper mismatch — maybe the tool-calling wrapper got a breaking change in the runtime or the validation lib. Which PRs touched tool schema parsers in the last 24h?

maria: PRs merged in last 24h: #1023 (auth-proxy: rotate header format), #1024 (runtime: streaming perf tweak), #1025 (tests: tighten toolcall schema). Any of those plausible?

priya: #1023 changes header key from X-User-Token -> X-RW-Token — if tests still send old key some requests become unauthorized. That explains 401s. The schema mismatch might be from #1025 tightening validation; combination causes flake.

alex: OK plan: 1) keep test cluster pinned to a9f3d2 for hosted-auth while we roll back #1023 in staging, 2) revert schema tightening in tests (or relax) so we don't get new failures, 3) open a bisect if reruns still red after pins.

noah: I'll open a quick PR to relax the test parser and run unit tests locally. Taking it now.

priya: Rollback of header change started (image -> a9f3d2). ETA ~5m.

ci-bot: Build #374.rerun-1 still failing on some nodes, rerun scheduled again on pinned cluster.

noah: PR to relax parser: https://git.example/redwood/runtime/pulls/1030 — lowered strictness on tool field names. Kicked off CI.

maria: Thanks. If CI passes on that PR and pinned cluster shows green we can mark this incident as "test-only regression" and follow-up to reintroduce header change with dual-readiness.

alex: Updated incident note in ops: https://wiki.redwood/ops/incident/hosted-integ-1923456789 — tagging follow-ups: AUTH-108 (dual-header support), TESTS-56 (schema compatibility).

priya: Pin finished; rerun on pinned cluster now.

ci-bot: Build #374.rerun-2 — all shards green on pinned cluster :white_check_mark:

alex: Nice — thanks everyone. Action items: priya will coordinate proper rollout of header format with dual-readiness, noah will merge the parser-relax change as a temporary guard, maria will track follow-up tickets. I'll close this thread once follow-ups are created. :thumbsup:

maria: Created tickets: AUTH-108, TESTS-56, DEVEXP-12. Assigning owners.

noah: Merging PR 1030 now.

priya: Will schedule a safe rollout plan for header change later today.

alex: Closing — please reopen if any more flakes. Thanks.
